question: Which counties nationwide should Punctual Pros expand to first?
html:
Where Punctual Pros Should Expand First

Expand first inside the Mid-Atlantic, not nationwide. The first counties are Chester County, PA, New Castle County, DE, and the Monmouth–Middlesex–Somerset–Union–Essex belt in New Jersey, after filling in the Central-PA core (Punctual Pros nationwide plan; Punctual Pros add-on targets). The material provided does not include a national county ranking, so any order beyond these is an est.

Why near home comes first

  • The growth plan runs in four phases. Phase 1 (months 0–12) fills the 248 core Central-PA ZIP codes and the 195 best nearby ZIP codes: 144 in PA and 51 in MD (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • Phase 2 (months 9–24) repeats the Horvath deal across PA, NJ, MD, DE and southern NY. The plan maps 54 Authority territories there that Punctual Pros does not own (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • Across the case set, the first add-on came a median of about 7 months after entry. It was usually close to home and was followed by a tuck-in every three to five months (value creation cases).

1Lancaster hub, PALancaster Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical (84), 5 miles from HQ
2Chester, PARon Williams tri-brand, West Chester (82)
3Monmouth, Middlesex, Somerset, Union, Essex, NJC&C Air Conditioning (82), ~65 employees
4Mechanicsburg area, PAZimmerman Plumbing (80), founder-led for 46 years
5South Jersey (Pleasantville)PHE / Punctual Pros NJ tri-brand (80)

(Punctual Pros add-on targets)

After the Mid-Atlantic core

  • Phase 3 (months 18–36): an I-81/I-95 hub covering Baltimore-DC, Richmond, the Philadelphia suburbs and Pittsburgh (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • Phase 4: national consolidation within the One Hour / Ben Franklin / Mister Sparky system. That system has 1,066 outlets and $831M of reported revenue; Punctual Pros holds ~2.3% today (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • What a national ranking would need: a sort of the national counties table by housing units, heating and cooling degree days, Redfin housing fields and Authority outlet counts. That output is not in the material provided.
  • Connecticut gap: climate, Redfin and Authority fields are null for Connecticut because of the planning-region mismatch (national counties).

Risks to sequencing

  • 17 PE sponsors are competing for the same founders in Phase 2 geographies (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • Employee and revenue figures for most targets are unverified because ZoomInfo enrichment was unavailable (Punctual Pros add-on targets).

Next actions

  1. Run a county ranking from the national counties table for PA, NJ, MD, DE and NY. Weight it by owner-occupied units and unowned Authority territories.
  2. Open founder conversations with Lancaster Plumbing and the Ron Williams group. One relationship covers both Chester County and Delmarva.
  3. Buy or license employee and revenue data for the top 10 targets before preparing LOIs.
  4. Build a Phase 3 county shortlist for Baltimore-DC, Richmond and Pittsburgh by month 12.

# Where Punctual Pros Should Expand First

Expand first inside the Mid-Atlantic, not nationwide. The first counties are Chester County, PA, New Castle County, DE, and the Monmouth–Middlesex–Somerset–Union–Essex belt in New Jersey, after filling in the Central-PA core (Punctual Pros nationwide plan; Punctual Pros add-on targets). The material provided does not include a national county ranking, so any order beyond these is an est.

## Why near home comes first

- The growth plan runs in four phases. Phase 1 (months 0–12) fills the 248 core Central-PA ZIP codes and the 195 best nearby ZIP codes: 144 in PA and 51 in MD (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- Phase 2 (months 9–24) repeats the Horvath deal across PA, NJ, MD, DE and southern NY. The plan maps 54 Authority territories there that Punctual Pros does not own (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- Across the case set, the first add-on came a median of about 7 months after entry. It was usually close to home and was followed by a tuck-in every three to five months (value creation cases).

## Priority counties

| Priority | County / area | Anchor target (fit score) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Lancaster hub, PA | Lancaster Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical (84), 5 miles from HQ |
| 2 | Chester, PA | Ron Williams tri-brand, West Chester (82) |
| 3 | Monmouth, Middlesex, Somerset, Union, Essex, NJ | C&C Air Conditioning (82), ~65 employees |
| 4 | Mechanicsburg area, PA | Zimmerman Plumbing (80), founder-led for 46 years |
| 5 | South Jersey (Pleasantville) | PHE / Punctual Pros NJ tri-brand (80) |
| 6 | New Castle, DE; Worcester, MD | Calvert's Wilmington; Ron Williams Delmarva |

(Punctual Pros add-on targets)

## After the Mid-Atlantic core

- **Phase 3 (months 18–36):** an I-81/I-95 hub covering Baltimore-DC, Richmond, the Philadelphia suburbs and Pittsburgh (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- **Phase 4:** national consolidation within the One Hour / Ben Franklin / Mister Sparky system. That system has 1,066 outlets and $831M of reported revenue; Punctual Pros holds ~2.3% today (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- **What a national ranking would need:** a sort of the national counties table by housing units, heating and cooling degree days, Redfin housing fields and Authority outlet counts. That output is not in the material provided.
- **Connecticut gap:** climate, Redfin and Authority fields are null for Connecticut because of the planning-region mismatch (national counties).

## Risks to sequencing

- 17 PE sponsors are competing for the same founders in Phase 2 geographies (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- Employee and revenue figures for most targets are unverified because ZoomInfo enrichment was unavailable (Punctual Pros add-on targets).

## Next actions

1. Run a county ranking from the national counties table for PA, NJ, MD, DE and NY. Weight it by owner-occupied units and unowned Authority territories.
2. Open founder conversations with Lancaster Plumbing and the Ron Williams group. One relationship covers both Chester County and Delmarva.
3. Buy or license employee and revenue data for the top 10 targets before preparing LOIs.
4. Build a Phase 3 county shortlist for Baltimore-DC, Richmond and Pittsburgh by month 12.
